Package edu.bu.pas.hex.tree

Class ATPZSQNode

java.lang.Object
edu.bu.pas.hex.tree.Node
edu.bu.pas.hex.tree.ATPZSNode
edu.bu.pas.hex.tree.ATPZSQNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public final class ATPZSQNode extends ATPZSNode implements Cloneable
A class that represents an ATPZSNode that contains a vector of q-values (defined for a single player's perspective). A q-value is the "utility" of an action in a state. This ATPZSNode preallocates a q-value per Action available to the current player as well as tracks the number of times this node has been visited during the game tree expansion.

  • Method Details

    • addSample

      public final void addSample(Action action, double qValue)
      A method to add a measured value to the average q-value for a specific action inside this ATPZSQNode. This instance stores averages of q-values (one q-value per Action) which are allocated in a lazy-manner. Use this method to increment statistics for a particular q-value providing a sample of performance you might get if you chose this Action in this state.
      Parameters:
      action - The Action whose q-value you want to update.
      qValue - The sample of performance choosing this Action might get. Will increment the average of the internal q-value for the provided Action by this amount.

    • getAverageQValue

      public final Double getAverageQValue(Action action)
      A method to get the average Q-value for an Action for the GenericGame stored inside this node. If there have been no samples provided for this Action the returned value will be null.
      Parameters:
      action - The Action to get the average Q-value of.
      Returns:
      The average Q-value. Will be null if no samples have been provided.

    • getNumSamples

      public final int getNumSamples(Action action)
      A method to get the number of times a specific Action has been tried in this state. Note that if this returns 0 then getAverageQValue will return null.
      Parameters:
      action - The Action to get the number of samples for.
      Returns:
      The number of samples for that Action.

    • getNumSamples

      public final int getNumSamples()
      A method to get the number of times this ATPZSQNode has had samples added to its internal q-values. This should always be the same value as if we were to add up all of the number of samples across the internal q-values of this ATPZSQNode.
      Returns:
      The number of total samples added to this ATPZSQNode

    • getChild

      public Node getChild(Action a) throws Exception
      Generates a child ATPZSQNode where the depth has been increased by 1, the Action has been applied, and the player has been alternated. The parent of the child has been set but the parent has *not* cached the child. If you wish to cache the child you should call the addChild method.
      Specified by:
      getChild in class Node
      Parameters:
      a - The action to generate the child ATPZSQNode with.
      Returns:
      The child ATPZSQNode with the parent set. The parent has *not* cached the child.
      Throws:
      Exception
